title: Noisy influence at noise rate one
statement:
Fix a coordinate $i \in [n]$ and a Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$. At noise rate $\rho = 1$, the noisy influence of $i$ on $f$ coincides with the ordinary influence of $i$ on $f$:
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i^{1}[f] \;=\; \mathrm{Inf}_i[f].
\]
hypotheses_covered: coordinate i of the n-dimensional cube
Boolean function f of arity n
replaced:
At noise rate $\rho = 1$ the noisy influence coincides with the ordinary influence:
$\mathrm{Inf}_i^{1}[f] = \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$.
